about: Every stadium surface a sponsor or the school can own, and which are for sale, painted or live (never offered). Restored November 2 from what the kit's branding-slots.json carried (lib/stadium.mjs before the purge, docs/EDITOR-PLUGIN.md, docs/dev/ad-library-inventory.md, the old Marketplace's spots); the stadium kit on the owner's PC keeps its own copy, with the per-team recipe and overlay the plugin needs. lib/office/assets.mjs reads this file: `catalog` names the ad library's surface types that fit, `art` how a library item goes up (whole: the texture as it is; crop: one brand's region of a multi-ad sheet; logo: one brand's logo, scaled into the slot), `native` the kit texture's size at Kennesaw St. (null: not read), `plugin` what tools/editor-plugin builds today.

kinds.sale: for sale: a sponsor can own it
kinds.painted: painted: the school's own art, put there by the mod (not inventory)
kinds.live: live LED or video in the game: never offered
kinds.none: no branding, or not mapped yet
